address: Radisson Blu Lyon, 129 rue Servient, Lyon, 69003, France
bio: On the 32nd floor of the Part-Dieu Tower (165m in total), which is dubbed The Pencil, you can take in the magnificent city while sampling minimalist fare that gives pride of place to the ingredient. Cauliflower, sweetcorn and honey; Dombes duckling and wild mushrooms; pear and pink pepper-flavoured rice…...
